issue.title: [Bug] `web_search_20250305`: text 块始终没有 `citations[]`，依赖 `cited_text` 的客户端只能拿到 url+title（DSH 的 web_search 因此「搜到了但没有内容」）
issue.body:
## 环境

- magpie **0.1.1364**（macOS，App 版，网关 `127.0.0.1:3425`）
- DeepSeek Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2**，profile `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`
- DSH 的搜索插件 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`（provider id `deepseek-official`）被路由到 magpie：
  ```yaml
  - id: web-search-deepseek
    name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek"
    config:
      apiKeyEnv: MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY
      baseURL: "http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1"
      model: "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
  ```

## 现象

DSH 里每一次 `web_search` 都只返回**标题 + 链接**，没有任何摘要/正文，用户侧表现为「联网搜索不可用」。

网关这条链其实是**成功**的：请求 200，`server_tool_use` 和 `web_search_tool_result` 都在，结果条目也有（6～10 条）。问题在于**响应里的 `text` 块 `citations` 恒为空数组** —— 而 `citations[].cited_text` 是 Anthropic 协议下唯一承载摘要摘录的字段（官方文档：*Citations are always enabled for web search*；`web_search_result_location` 含 `url` / `title` / `encrypted_index` / `cited_text`）。

下游 DSH 的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` 正是只用 `citations[].cited_text` 来生成 `snippet`：

```js
function citationSnippets(blocks) {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const block of blocks) {
    if (block.type !== "text") continue;
    for (const cite of block.citations ?? [])
      if (cite.url && cite.cited_text && !map.has(cite.url)) map.set(cite.url, cite.cited_text);
  }
  return map;
}
```

`citations` 为空 ⇒ `sources` 里每条只剩 `url` + `title` ⇒ 模型拿到的信息量为零。

## 复现（curl 直打网关，100% 复现）

```bash
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/messages \
  -H "x-api-key: $MAGPIE_GATEWAY_KEY" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Perform a web search for the query: 江苏智库智能科技有限公司 招聘"}]}],
    "tools": [{"type":"web_search_20250305","name":"web_search","max_uses":5}],
    "thinking": {"type":"disabled"}
  }'
```

（请求体与 DSH 插件发出的完全一致，见 DSH 会话日志 `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` 事件。）

## 实测结果矩阵

两条**不同上游**的路由都一样，说明不是某一个中转的怪癖：

| `model` 入参 | 实际路由到 | `web_search_tool_result` 条目 | `text` 块长度 | `citations` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `raccoon/sn-deepseek-v4-1-flash` | 6 | 1663 字符 | **0** |
| `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | 10 | 1933 字符 | **0** |

两条路由的 `web_search_result` 条目字段均为：
`['type','title','url','encrypted_content','page_age']` —— **没有** `snippet`/`text`/`cited_text` 之类的摘录字段。

响应块序列（第一条路由）：

```
[thinking]
[server_tool_use]                 ← 模型确实发起了搜索
[web_search_tool_result] items=6
[thinking]
[text] len=1663 citations=0       ← 有正文，但没有 citations
```

> 注意到 `web_search_result` 条目带 `encrypted_content`，这是**原生透传**的特征（magpie 没有走自己的代搜管线，而是把工具转发给上游的 Anthropic 兼容端点）。

## 期望

按 Anthropic 规范，web search 的 `text` 块应当带 `citations[]`，每项形如：

```json
{
  "type": "web_search_result_location",
  "url": "https://...",
  "title": "...",
  "encrypted_index": "...",
  "cited_text": "被引用的最多 150 字符原文"
}
```

## 影响面（不只影响 DSH）

任何按 Anthropic 规范从 `citations[].cited_text` 取摘要的 Messages 客户端都会退化成「只有标题」。

而 DSH 的情况更糟：它的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` **只**用 `web_search_tool_result` + citations 组装 `sources`，那段 1663/1933 字符的 `text` 正文被**整个丢弃**，所以用户最终连"模型已经搜到了什么"都看不到。

## 建议修法（按改动量排序）

1. **在转译层补 `citations`**：当上游返回的 `text` 块没有 citations、但同响应里有 `web_search_tool_result` 时，为 `sources` 里的条目合成一个最小 `web_search_result_location`（`url` + `title` + 由 `page_age`/标题生成的 `cited_text` 占位）。这样至少让下游不空手。
2. **让代搜管线产出 citations**：magpie 自己的 searcher（#669 修好的那条路）本来就自己构造 `web_search_tool_result`，可以顺带填充 `cited_text`（searcher 有正文，`cited_text` 截 150 字符即可，完全在 magpie 能力范围内）。
3. **暴露能力信号**：若上游确实无法提供 citations，至少让客户端能判断「这次搜索结果没有摘要」，而不是静默返回一堆裸 URL。
4. 顺带：`searchFirst` 当前是 `api`，但这次实际仍是转发到上游 provider（路由日志 `provider: commandcode`）。如果代搜能提供更完整的结果+citations，建议在客户端依赖 citations 时优先走代搜。

## 相关

- #3206 —— server-managed tools 在翻译路由上被**整体丢弃**（本条不同：工具正常执行，只是 citations 缺失）
- #3047 —— 按模型声明原生 web_search 能力
- #669 —— 代搜回传空 `web_search_tool_result.content`（已修，同类"客户端表现为搜索不可用"）
- #2726 —— dsh 的 `web-search-deepseek` 被改写到网关
- #2044 —— 在翻译后的 Responses 回复里保留 web search 结果

## 附：DSH 侧可互补的一处

DSH 的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` 完全不读 `text` 块。即使 magpie 这次补齐了 citations，那段真正的正文仍然会被丢弃。DSH 侧可以加个兜底：citations 为空时，至少把 `text` 正文作为 `content` 返回。这部分属于 DSH 的改动，不是 magpie 的问题，仅作上下文说明。

comments.body: Taking this. Direction verified on current main (dd1e8822): magpie's Anthropic stream side already knows citations (whole_stream.go re-emits a text block's `citations` as `citations_delta`), but the `web_search_20250305` tool-result-to-text translation fills none — so every client that reads `citations[].cited_text` (DSH's `mapAnthropicResponse`) gets zero snippets. Will trace both upstream shapes (relay passthrough and translated Chat) before composing the fix; patch to follow on my fork.

根因确认：你这两条路由走的都是 **magpie 自己的代搜管线**（raccoon/sn-deepseek 与 deepseek 官方都不在「上游自己会搜」的名单里，`searchHosts`），回复由 magpie 翻译成 Anthropic 形状——`server_tool_use` / `web_search_tool_result` 块是 magpie 合成的，而 magpie 从不给 text 块放 citations（修复前全仓库连 `web_search_result_location` 都不存在）。模型其实拿到过每页的摘录文本，客户端却一条也看不到。

修复分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1024pm（commit [e5a05c44](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/e5a05c44)，基于 main dd1e8822）：

- `Hit` 带上「模型自己看到的页面摘录」（搜索后端给的文本，按 Anthropic 的 `cited_text` 上限截 150 字符）；
- **整包回复**：搜索之后的第一个 text 块带 `citations[]`，每项 `{type: "web_search_result_location", url, title, encrypted_index: "", cited_text}`——`encrypted_index` 为空是诚实的：magpie 没有封印任何东西；
- **流式回复**：text 块以空 `citations` 开块，每条 citation 以 `citations_delta` 先于文字送出——正是 Anthropic 自家 web search 的流式形状，DSH 的 `mapAnthropicResponse()` 直接可用；
- 没有摘录的命中（搜索后端没给文本、或走 searcher 模型路径）**不造** citation，不发明内容。

**验证**：whole 与 streamed 两路断言（含「无摘录不引用」负例），只回退编码器时红；`Search|Anthropic` 相关 221 项测试绿（`TestSearchCitedOnTheTextAfterIt`）。你的两条真实路由麻烦在装了该分支的网关上再 curl 一轮——按修复，text 块的 citations 里应能拿到每条结果的摘录。

## Summary

`/v1/messages` with the `web_search_20250305` tool answered with its `web_search_tool_result` and the text that read it, but the text carried no `citations[]` — so every client that reads `citations[].cited_text` for its snippets (dsh's `mapAnthropicResponse`) got urls alone and showed "searched, nothing in it" (#3447). Where magpie searches for the model, the blocks are magpie's own making, and a `Hit` kept no excerpt at all: the search's quotes were dropped where the searcher's reply was read, so there was nothing to cite. The fix keeps what was quoted of each page and carries those quotes as the citations of the text that read it.

## What changed

Two upstream shapes behind the issue, traced on `dd1e8822`:

- **`auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash` → the raccoon relay**: the model searches by itself on no API (`searchHosts`, `searchModels`), so magpie searches for it (`searchedForIt`) and the reply is translated — `server_tool_use` / `web_search_tool_result` are magpie's own blocks (`anthropicEncoder`, `renderAnthropic`). This is where the citations were lost: `searchWith` read the searcher's `web_search_tool_result` keeping only title/url/page_age, a search API's page text was dropped in `pagesSaid`, and no code path ever wrote a `web_search_result_location` (none existed in the repo before this patch).
- **`deepseek/deepseek-flash` → api.deepseek.com**: the host is in `searchHosts[Anthropic]`, so the model searches by itself, `searchedForIt` is false and the reply is relayed by `passthrough` byte for byte. Its `web_search_tool_result` entries (`type/title/url/encrypted_content/page_age`, no excerpt) and citation-less text are DeepSeek's own shape; magpie does not touch them and cannot — there is no excerpt to cite, and none is invented. (The two routers' identical entry shape in the issue's matrix is DeepSeek's own; magpie's synthesized entries also carry those five fields, with `encrypted_content` always empty.)

Changes (product diff +58/-9, one commit):

- `Hit` keeps `CitedText` — what the search quoted of the page (`""` when it gave none).
- `searchWith` keeps a searcher entry's `cited_text` when it has one; `pagesSaid` clips a search API's page text to `citedTextMost` (150, as much as Anthropic's own search quotes). A Claude-subscription search result unmarshals into `Hit` and picks `cited_text` up by itself.
- The text that read a search carries its quotes as `citations[]`, each a `web_search_result_location` (`type/url/title/cited_text`): streamed as `citations_delta` ahead of the text (the same shape `whole_stream.go` already replays a text's citations with), whole beside it. `web_search_tool_result` entries carry the excerpt too, as Anthropic's own do.
- A page nothing was quoted of gives no citation — none is invented — and a searcher's sealed content stays sealed (`encrypted_content` still always empty; sealed `encrypted_index` is not relayed either).

Sibling faces checked, left alone: `anthropicWholeEvents`'s citations replay (already correct, untouched); `decodeAnthropic` drops an upstream's `citations_delta` on the translated stream path — real, but no path in this issue goes through it (the relay relays, the search-for path parses whole replies) and carrying citations through the IR is a separate, larger change; `responsesSearchItem` is the `/v1/responses` shape, another protocol; Gemini Code Assist and Responses `web_search_call` hits have no excerpt to keep.

Cost on the hot path: one pass over a search's hits (≤10) when a search event arrives; a reply with no search writes no `citations` key and is byte-identical to before.

## Notes

- skygunner's comment above says both routers in the issue's matrix go through magpie's search-for pipeline. On `dd1e8822` the deepseek official host is in `searchHosts[Anthropic]` (`search.go`), `searchesItself` is true for it (`TestDeepSeekNativeSearchResults` asserts it), so `deepseek/deepseek-flash` is relayed, not searched for. Its entries reach the client as DeepSeek wrote them — which is why both routers showed the same five-field shape. The two upstreams' failures have different seats; this patch fixes magpie's own making, and leaves the relayed shape as the vendor wrote it.
- The excerpts carried are the searcher's own quotes or a search API's text of the page, clipped to 150. Where an upstream gives no excerpt (DeepSeek's sealed entries), no citation is written: a `cited_text` is not made up.

## Summary

`/v1/messages` with the `web_search_20250305` tool answered with its `web_search_tool_result` and the text that read it, but the text carried no `citations[]` — so every client that reads `citations[].cited_text` for its snippets (dsh's `mapAnthropicResponse`) got urls alone and showed "searched, nothing in it" (#3447). Where magpie searches for the model, the blocks are magpie's own making, and a `Hit` kept no excerpt at all: the search's quotes were dropped where the searcher's reply was read, so there was nothing to cite. The fix keeps what was quoted of each page and carries those quotes as the citations of the text that read it.

## What changed

Two upstream shapes behind the issue, traced on `dd1e8822`:

- **`auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash` → the raccoon relay**: the model searches by itself on no API (`searchHosts`, `searchModels`), so magpie searches for it (`searchedForIt`) and the reply is translated — `server_tool_use` / `web_search_tool_result` are magpie's own blocks (`anthropicEncoder`, `renderAnthropic`). This is where the citations were lost: `searchWith` read the searcher's `web_search_tool_result` keeping only title/url/page_age, a search API's page text was dropped in `pagesSaid`, and no code path ever wrote a `web_search_result_location` (none existed in the repo before this patch).
- **`deepseek/deepseek-flash` → api.deepseek.com**: the host is in `searchHosts[Anthropic]`, so the model searches by itself, `searchedForIt` is false and the reply is relayed by `passthrough` byte for byte. Its `web_search_tool_result` entries (`type/title/url/encrypted_content/page_age`, no excerpt) and citation-less text are DeepSeek's own shape; magpie does not touch them and cannot — there is no excerpt to cite, and none is invented. (The two routers' identical entry shape in the issue's matrix is DeepSeek's own; magpie's synthesized entries also carry those five fields, with `encrypted_content` always empty.)

Changes (product diff +58/-9, one commit):

- `Hit` keeps `CitedText` — what the search quoted of the page (`""` when it gave none).
- `searchWith` keeps a searcher entry's `cited_text` when it has one; `pagesSaid` clips a search API's page text to `citedTextMost` (150, as much as Anthropic's own search quotes). A Claude-subscription search result unmarshals into `Hit` and picks `cited_text` up by itself.
- The text that read a search carries its quotes as `citations[]`, each a `web_search_result_location` (`type/url/title/cited_text`): streamed as `citations_delta` ahead of the text (the same shape `whole_stream.go` already replays a text's citations with), whole beside it. `web_search_tool_result` entries carry the excerpt too, as Anthropic's own do.
- A page nothing was quoted of gives no citation — none is invented — and a searcher's sealed content stays sealed (`encrypted_content` still always empty; sealed `encrypted_index` is not relayed either).

Sibling faces checked, left alone: `anthropicWholeEvents`'s citations replay (already correct, untouched); `decodeAnthropic` drops an upstream's `citations_delta` on the translated stream path — real, but no path in this issue goes through it (the relay relays, the search-for path parses whole replies) and carrying citations through the IR is a separate, larger change; `responsesSearchItem` is the `/v1/responses` shape, another protocol; Gemini Code Assist and Responses `web_search_call` hits have no excerpt to keep.

Cost on the hot path: one pass over a search's hits (≤10) when a search event arrives; a reply with no search writes no `citations` key and is byte-identical to before.

issue.body:
### 插件说明

- **包名**：`magpie-dsh-websearch`
- **显示名称**：`DSH WebSearch Citations`
- **类型**：`middleware` (网关中间件)
- **开源仓库**：https://github.com/MDX-Tom/magpie-dsh-websearch
- **开源协议**：MIT

### 背景与解决的痛点

在当前版本 Magpie 中，DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 作为 Agent 接入 Magpie 时，使用联网搜索（Web Search）获取的搜索引用正文与摘要经常缺失：
- **原因**：Magpie 的 Anthropic Messages 协议端点返回的 `content` 块通常仅包含裸文本或纯 URL 引用，未组装完整的 `citations[].cited_text` / `citations[].snippet`。
- **后果**：DeepSeek Harness 渲染检索结果时无法展示引用摘要与来源卡片，只显示空白外链或丢失搜索上下文，严重影响联网问答的阅读与校验体验。

### 处理方法与核心特性

本插件作为轻量级网关层出站中间件（Gateway Middleware）：
1. **出站响应拦截与补全**：拦截并解析 Anthropic `/v1/messages` 响应，提取模型回答中的引用锚点与网页结果 URL，智能切分段落正文，自动合成符合 Anthropic 官方规范的 `citations[]` 数组。
2. **多源协议适配**：深度兼容 OpenAI 兼容端点（注入 `annotations`）与 Anthropic Messages 规范，确保下游 DSH 能无缝还原带正文预览与来源标题的交互式卡片。
3. **零额外网络延迟**：基于网关内置 moejs 微内核极速执行（单次处理 < 1 µs），支持在 Magpie GUI 插件选项中灵活设置引用正文字符上限与最大引用条数。
4. **防御性容错**：遵循网关中间件无异常抛出规范，遇到非标准响应时安全直通，绝不破坏用户正常对话。

### 测试与验证

- 中间件已通过本地 Node.js 自动化单元测试套件验证（5/5 通过）。
- 本仓库 `scripts/registry.mjs` 格式校验通过（0 errors）。

issue.body:
## 关联背景与中间件的作用
针对 PR [magpie-community/plugins#656](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/656)（`magpie-dsh-websearch`），@yetone 详细分析了为何该 PR 不宜作为通用插件合并入官方插件库（如涉及 fake citations 覆盖、OpenAI 字段类型 `url_citation` 回传可能被拒、以及缺乏流式覆盖等）。这些架构与规范层面的审阅意见完全中肯且专业。

但从**用户真实场景与实际功能链路**来看，该中间件的开发与落地起到了至关重要的**桥梁与验证作用**：

1. **业务兜底与救急价值**：在当前 Magpie 环境下，DSH 使用 `web_search` 搜索时，因缺少 `citations` 导致前端拿到的 snippet 全部为空，仅能输出毫无信息量的裸链接（如无法直接获取天气数值、时效预报等）。该中间件作为无需修改 DSH 内部 asar 源码的纯网关方案，**在第一时间成功为用户兜底打通了链路**，使 DSH 的端到端搜索结果重新具备可用摘要。
2. **端到端契约的概念验证（PoC）**：该中间件在实践中验证了下游 Agent（如 DSH 的 `citationSnippets` 提取机制）的真实期待——只要响应的 `text` 块带上与搜索结果 URL 绑定的 citations，DSH 的渲染层就能完美工作，无需任何 agent 侧补丁。
3. **推动核心修复的关键触发点**：正因为中间件在实践中被广泛需要，才反向暴露出 Issue [yetone/magpie#3447](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3447)（commit `1d6b72ad`）在特定路由（如 Vertex Grounding、开源免费模型路由等）下并未真正生效的深层 Bug。**中间件的角色不应是永久替代方案，而是一个明确指出“核心究竟缺失了什么”的原型蓝图。**

依据 @yetone 在 PR 关闭时的指引（*“如果你在 v0.1.1369 之后的 magpie 上用 DSH 联网搜索，仍然看到没有摘要，请在 yetone/magpie 开 issue，附上 magpie 版本、所用的模型和路由，以及那次响应的原始字节。有这些我们就能在核心里修”*），我们在完全关闭该中间件的纯净原生环境下，排查了 DeepSeek Harness 会话 `session-c9482063-443d-4404-b1ee-4333c9162cfb`，并对最新版本 `magpie 0.1.2775` 进行了全面的对比抓包测试。

```javascript
// DSH 的 snippet 提取只认 text block 上的 citations 映射：
for (const citation of textBlock.citations || []) {
  if (citation.type === "web_search_result_location" && citation.url === item.url) {
    item.snippet = citation.cited_text;
  }
}
```
且 DSH 明确拒绝将模型的总结 prose 作为回答文本回填（*"`content` is always omitted: DeepSeek's provider prose is not trusted as an answer"*）。

由此产生了鲜明对比：
- **无中间件（原生 Magpie core）**：
  - `web_search_result` 没有明文 snippet（`encrypted_content` 为客户端无法解密的密文或空串）。
  - `text` 块未附带 `citations[]`（流式也无 `citations_delta`）。
  - DSH 提取不到任何 snippet，最终只能降级展示一堆不含正文的裸链接：
    ```markdown
    - [中国天气网：北京天气预报](https://www.weather.com.cn/...)
    - [中央气象台：北京天气预报](https://www.nmc.cn/...)
    ```
- **有中间件介入时**：
  - 中间件捕捉到 `web_search_tool_result`，将提炼的答案绑定到每条 URL 的 `citations` 上。
  - DSH 的 `citationSnippets` 瞬间全部命中，UI 上立刻展现 `- [标题](URL) — 摘要正文`，搜索链路直接可用。
  - **这直接印证了：DSH 客户端链路没有任何问题，只要核心把 citations 填上，整个体验就是完整的闭环。**

---

## 根因定位与修复建议
- **#3447 在什么情况下能跑通**：若上游直接对接官方 Anthropic Claude API，且上游厂商原生输出了 `citations` / `web_search_result_location`，Magpie 透传时可正常保留（这也是 HuHong-Tao 和 ggbdpq 在 0.1.1371 上验证通过的场景）。
- **在什么情况下失效**：当 Magpie 走本地默认的 Google Vertex Grounding 检索通道（`"searcher": "antigravity"`）时，Google 返回的是 `groundingChunks` 与 `groundingSupports`。Magpie 的 Anthropic 协议转换层在处理此类响应时，**未将 Grounding 的切片引用转换为 Anthropic 标准的 `web_search_result_location` 并挂入 `text.citations`**。

### 建议解决方案
希望 Magpie 核心团队能够接过此中间件验证过的职责，在 Core 层实现正规的原生支持：
1. 在 Grounding -> Anthropic 适配器中，解析 Grounding 引用切片（<= 150 字），构建正规的 Anthropic `web_search_result_location` 对象：
   ```json
   {
     "type": "web_search_result_location",
     "url": "<source_url>",
     "title": "<source_title>",
     "cited_text": "<page_excerpt_up_to_150_chars>"
   }
   ```
2. 将该列表附加到对应的 `text` block 的 `citations` 数组中。
3. 在流式模式下，在对应 text 块结束前发射 `citations_delta`。

issue.title: gateway: a held text block's citations go before its content_block_start — Claude Code's WebSearch ends "The search was cut off before any results arrived"

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

A Messages-to-Messages stream with `tools` can send a held text block's `citations_delta` before that block's `content_block_start`.

`anthropicTextCalls.event` holds an empty text block's start in `startHeld` while it looks for calls written into the text. In its `content_block_delta` branch, any delta that is not `text_delta` is returned as it came, without releasing the held start. OpenRouter's Messages endpoint writes a searched reply as a `server_tool_use` block, then a text block that carries only `citations_delta`s (its `content_block_start` has `"text": ""` and no text follows), then the answer in another text block. The citations therefore reach the client before the block's start.

Claude Code's stream reader treats a delta for a content block it never saw start as a broken stream, finalizes the partial response, and its `WebSearch` tool reports `The search was cut off before any results arrived. Try again.` The same request sent directly to OpenRouter works.

## Environment

- magpie **0.1.3358** (installed app), macOS 27.0, arm64.
- The relay code named below is unchanged on `main` at `c7ebb6f8d` when this was written.
- Provider: a custom OpenRouter provider (`anthropic: https://openrouter.ai/api`, `responses: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`, `searches: true`), model `openrouter/~deepseek/deepseek-flash-latest`.
- Client: Claude Code **2.1.319**, its `WebSearch` tool.

## Symptom

Claude Code's `WebSearch` sends this sub-request (only the fields that matter):

```json
{
  "model": "openrouter/~deepseek/deepseek-flash-latest",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Perform a web search for the query: Tokyo current time"}]}],
  "system": [
    {"type": "text", "text": "You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK."},
    {"type": "text", "text": "You run a web search for another Claude model, which is waiting on the result and can search again. Search once, then reply with a brief summary of the results."}
  ],
  "tools": [{"type": "web_search_20250305", "name": "web_search", "max_uses": 8}],
  "tool_choice": {"type": "auto"},
  "max_tokens": 128000,
  "output_config": {"effort": "max"},
  "stream": true
}
```

- Direct to OpenRouter (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api`): `WebSearch` returns results (`webSearchRequests: 1`).
- Through magpie: every attempt fails after about 2 s with `The search was cut off before any results arrived. Try again.`; the gateway log has `499 after 1.94s: the agent canceled the request`.
- Claude Code's debug log: `[WARN] Stream event referenced an unstarted content block after 1 block(s) yielded — finalizing partial response`.

## Wire capture

The same request body replayed directly to OpenRouter and through magpie (both streams end with `message_delta`/`message_stop`):

Direct OpenRouter:

```text
message_start
start0:server_tool_use | delta0:input_json_delta ... | stop0
start1:text | delta1:citations_delta ×5 | stop1
start2:text | delta2:text_delta ... | stop2
message_delta | message_stop
```

Through magpie:

```text
message_start
start0:server_tool_use | delta0:input_json_delta ... | stop0
delta1:citations_delta ×5        <-- before block 1's start
start1:text | stop1
start2:text | delta2:text_delta ... | stop2
message_delta | message_stop
```

A pass-through tap between magpie and OpenRouter shows the upstream's own order is `start1` before the citations, so the swap happens in magpie's relay.

## Root cause

`internal/gateway/textcalls_anthropic.go`, `anthropicTextCalls.event`, `case "content_block_delta"` (line 104 on `c7ebb6f8d`):

```go
if !t.text || index != t.idx || d.Type != "text_delta" {
    return ev
}
```

An empty text block's start is held in `t.startHeld`. A `citations_delta` of that block matches the first two conditions but not `text_delta`, so it is forwarded while the start is still held; the start is only released later, by the block's `content_block_stop`.
